title: pr-comment log.jsonl record
description: Usage errors, refusals, declined dialogs, vetoes and escalations before any write, moved findings with reasons, degraded suggestions, pre-check rounds, warnings and config warnings. A log write failure warns only. No bodies.

level.description: error for exit 1; warn for refusals, vetoes, escalations, declined dialogs and exit 12; info otherwise; debug with --verbose.

attempt_id.description: The run's attempt_id; null before one exists.

details.description: Untrusted: may hold host or draft text. Never bodies or secrets.
